1→# Phase 22 — Atlas bounded path-sensitive CPG continuation
2→
3→## PS1 — structured `if` control flow
4→
5→For braced `if` statements, `CFG_TRUE` enters the consequence and `CFG_FALSE` enters the
6→alternative when present, otherwise the join. An `else if` alternative enters the nested
7→`if_statement`; it is not collapsed into atomic fall-through. Every non-terminal branch tail reaches the join.
8→Literal `true`/`false` conditions omit the unreachable branch edge. Unbraced conditions, loops,
9→switches, short-circuit expressions, ternaries, and exception constructs remain atomic unless a
10→later contract expands them.
11→
12→## PS2 — bounded CFG may-reaching definitions
13→
14→`REACHING_DEF` means a same-function, same-binding-name definition may reach a reference through
15→the shipped CFG without another definition of that name on that path. Multiple definitions may
16→reach a join; this is neither lexical-last-def nor SSA/must-def. Definitions in a CFG-unreachable
17→literal branch do not reach later references. A deployment-supplied `maxReachDefPairs` ceiling is
18→mandatory and fails typed before an oversized relation is emitted.
19→When nested definitions collapse onto one reachable atomic unsupported-control anchor, same-name
20→definitions form a may-union rather than source-order last-wins.
21→
22→## PS3 — direct value edges
23→
24→Identifier-to-identifier declarator/assignment copies emit direct `ASSIGNED_FROM` edges. Call
25→assignment and `ARGUMENT_TO` edges describe only the direct RHS/direct argument, not every nested
26→descendant; nested expressions compose through their immediate calls instead of bypassing a
27→configured sanitizer.
28→
29→## PS4 — taint consumes CFG truth
30→
31→Operator-specified taint retains Phase 20 flow edge types and sanitizer cuts. Source and sink calls
32→anchored in CFG-unreachable statements are excluded. Richer may-reaching definitions preserve a
33→possible path across a branch join, while syntax-literal dead branches are pruned. Provenance says
34→`cfg_may_reach_value_graph_not_safety_proof`; a missing path is not a safety claim.
35→
36→## PS5 — explicit non-goals
37→
38→No claim is made for shadowing-aware binding identity, aliases, heap/object properties, implicit
39→or control taint, exceptions, interprocedural parameters/returns, dynamic dispatch, full PDG, SSA,
40→SAT/SMT condition solving, repository-wide flow, or unbraced conditional expansion.
41→Standalone bare statement blocks are not CFG spine nodes in this increment.
42→
43→## PS6 — artifact and lifecycle integrity
44→
45→Graph schema/version, content addressing, deterministic order, parse-partial status, cancellation,
46→result ceilings, bounded resume, tamper refusal, and reverify remain mandatory. Statement/value
47→nodes expose only deterministic statement anchors and CFG reachability facts derived from source.
48→
49→## PS7 — delta inheritance
50→
51→CPG delta compares the richer graph and impact may follow its richer `REACHING_DEF` relation.
52→This does not upgrade impact reachability into behavioral proof or path-sensitive impact.
53→
54→## PS8 — acceptance
55→
56→Red tests prove else entry and branch joins, literal dead-branch pruning, alternate may-reaching
57→definitions, direct copy flow, sanitizer non-bypass through nested calls, the mandatory relation
58→ceiling, retained direct-argument behavior, deterministic artifacts, and the explicit non-goals.
59→The combined R3 and canonical suites must stay green.
60→

# Phase 22 — Atlas bounded path-sensitive CPG continuation

## PS1 — structured `if` control flow

For braced `if` statements, `CFG_TRUE` enters the consequence and `CFG_FALSE` enters the
alternative when present, otherwise the join. An `else if` alternative enters the nested
`if_statement`; it is not collapsed into atomic fall-through. Every non-terminal branch tail reaches the join.
Literal `true`/`false` conditions omit the unreachable branch edge. Unbraced conditions, loops,
switches, short-circuit expressions, ternaries, and exception constructs remain atomic unless a
later contract expands them.

## PS2 — bounded CFG may-reaching definitions

`REACHING_DEF` means a same-function, same-binding-name definition may reach a reference through
the shipped CFG without another definition of that name on that path. Multiple definitions may
reach a join; this is neither lexical-last-def nor SSA/must-def. Definitions in a CFG-unreachable
literal branch do not reach later references. A deployment-supplied `maxReachDefPairs` ceiling is
mandatory and fails typed before an oversized relation is emitted.
When nested definitions collapse onto one reachable atomic unsupported-control anchor, same-name
definitions form a may-union rather than source-order last-wins.

## PS3 — direct value edges

Identifier-to-identifier declarator/assignment copies emit direct `ASSIGNED_FROM` edges. Call
assignment and `ARGUMENT_TO` edges describe only the direct RHS/direct argument, not every nested
descendant; nested expressions compose through their immediate calls instead of bypassing a
configured sanitizer.

## PS4 — taint consumes CFG truth

Operator-specified taint retains Phase 20 flow edge types and sanitizer cuts. Source and sink calls
anchored in CFG-unreachable statements are excluded. Richer may-reaching definitions preserve a
possible path across a branch join, while syntax-literal dead branches are pruned. Provenance says
`cfg_may_reach_value_graph_not_safety_proof`; a missing path is not a safety claim.

## PS5 — explicit non-goals

No claim is made for shadowing-aware binding identity, aliases, heap/object properties, implicit
or control taint, exceptions, interprocedural parameters/returns, dynamic dispatch, full PDG, SSA,
SAT/SMT condition solving, repository-wide flow, or unbraced conditional expansion.
Standalone bare statement blocks are not CFG spine nodes in this increment.

## PS6 — artifact and lifecycle integrity

Graph schema/version, content addressing, deterministic order, parse-partial status, cancellation,
result ceilings, bounded resume, tamper refusal, and reverify remain mandatory. Statement/value
nodes expose only deterministic statement anchors and CFG reachability facts derived from source.

## PS7 — delta inheritance

CPG delta compares the richer graph and impact may follow its richer `REACHING_DEF` relation.
This does not upgrade impact reachability into behavioral proof or path-sensitive impact.

## PS8 — acceptance

Red tests prove else entry and branch joins, literal dead-branch pruning, alternate may-reaching
definitions, direct copy flow, sanitizer non-bypass through nested calls, the mandatory relation
ceiling, retained direct-argument behavior, deterministic artifacts, and the explicit non-goals.
The combined R3 and canonical suites must stay green.

1→# Phase 22 Atlas bounded path-sensitive CPG evidence — 2026-07-11
2→
3→## Outcome
4→
5→PS1–PS8 ship as a bounded continuation of the existing single-file JS/TS-family CPG rather than a
6→claim of full path-sensitive program analysis. Braced `if`/`else` control now enters both correct
7→branches and rejoins through non-terminal tails. Boolean-literal dead branches are pruned. Lexical
8→last-definition was replaced by a deployment-bounded CFG may-reaching-definition relation, so all
9→definitions that can reach a join remain visible without claiming SSA or must-def semantics.
10→
11→Direct identifier copies now carry value through `ASSIGNED_FROM`. Assignment and argument edges
12→describe immediate values rather than every nested descendant, preventing an inner source call
13→from bypassing an operator-named sanitizer. Taint excludes calls in literal-dead structured
14→branches and reports `cfg_may_reach_value_graph_not_safety_proof`.
15→
16→Unsupported control remains explicitly atomic. The first Baton-on-Baton attempt caught a
17→regression where statements inside `try` were treated as unreachable. Nested occurrences under an
18→unsupported construct now collapse to the reachable outer statement, while a dead branch under a
19→structured literal `if` stays unreachable. The real `JSON.parse` to `server.handle` witness in
20→`impl/src/mcp-northbound.mjs` is preserved as a regression gate.
21→
22→## Validation
23→
24→- Numbered contract: `spec/phase22/atlas-cpg-path-sensitive.md`.
25→- Phase 22 focused red/green result: 9/9.
26→- Combined Phase 18/19/20/22 R3 gate: 29/29.
27→- Canonical suite: 731/731; owned suite root reaped.
28→- Baton-on-Baton proof: every check in
29→  `docs/reference/evidence/phase22-atlas-cpg-path-sensitive-2026-07-11/summary.json` is true. It
30→  built a 2,000-plus-node graph of the implementation itself, observed real CFG/may-def/copy
31→  relations, preserved the real MCP taint witness, exercised copy/branch/sanitizer composition,
32→  reverified deterministically, balanced audit events, and removed its temporary roots.
33→
34→## Recursive review and disagreement
35→
36→Two exact-model Grok workers reviewed the prior R3 implementation concurrently through Baton and
37→were independently fresh-verified, killed, and fully reaped. Both found the incorrect else edge;
38→one also found the copy-flow/card honesty gap. Their captured reports and normalized events are in
39→`docs/reference/evidence/phase22-atlas-path-sensitive-grok-review-2026-07-11/`.
40→
41→After implementation, two more exact-model Grok reviews independently found that `else if` sugar
42→caused the outer structured `if` to fall back to atomic flow, orphaning the nested branch and
43→creating a false-negative taint result. A red regression now requires the outer `CFG_FALSE` edge
44→to enter the nested `if`, requires that condition to be reachable, and preserves a source in the
45→middle arm through the join. The correction is covered by the 7/7 focused and 729/729 canonical
46→results. The finding reports and their fully reaped lifecycle evidence are under
47→`docs/reference/evidence/phase22-atlas-cpg-implementation-grok-review-2026-07-11/`.
48→
49→The first correction review then found a second composition defect: a structured `if` nested
50→inside an atomic unsupported parent formed a disconnected CFG island. Its successful Grok 4.5
51→report produced a red regression; the concurrent Composer process closed before its terminal frame,
52→and Baton still reaped both workers completely. Effective anchoring now climbs through a
53→disconnected structured island to the reachable atomic parent, while literal-dead arms remain
54→dead. Same-name definitions collapsed into one atomic region are retained as a may-union instead
55→of source-order last-wins. The failed-as-a-whole review attempt is preserved honestly under
56→`docs/reference/evidence/phase22-atlas-cpg-correction-grok-review-2026-07-11/`.
57→
58→The implementation deliberately rejected one proposal that would have removed a source-to-sink
59→path whenever the source occurred in a conditional branch. That is must-path reasoning, not
60→may-reachability, and would create a false negative when the branch is taken. Baton instead keeps
61→all may-reaching definitions at an unknown branch join and prunes only source-level boolean
62→literals.
63→
64→## Honest boundary
65→
66→This is not full path feasibility, SSA, a PDG, or a safety/exploitability proof. Shadowing-aware
67→binding identity, aliases, heap/properties, implicit/control taint, exceptions, general condition
68→solving, interprocedural parameters/returns, dynamic dispatch, unbraced conditional expansion, and
69→repository-wide flow remain unclaimed.
70→

# Phase 22 Atlas bounded path-sensitive CPG evidence — 2026-07-11

## Outcome

PS1–PS8 ship as a bounded continuation of the existing single-file JS/TS-family CPG rather than a
claim of full path-sensitive program analysis. Braced `if`/`else` control now enters both correct
branches and rejoins through non-terminal tails. Boolean-literal dead branches are pruned. Lexical
last-definition was replaced by a deployment-bounded CFG may-reaching-definition relation, so all
definitions that can reach a join remain visible without claiming SSA or must-def semantics.

Direct identifier copies now carry value through `ASSIGNED_FROM`. Assignment and argument edges
describe immediate values rather than every nested descendant, preventing an inner source call
from bypassing an operator-named sanitizer. Taint excludes calls in literal-dead structured
branches and reports `cfg_may_reach_value_graph_not_safety_proof`.

Unsupported control remains explicitly atomic. The first Baton-on-Baton attempt caught a
regression where statements inside `try` were treated as unreachable. Nested occurrences under an
unsupported construct now collapse to the reachable outer statement, while a dead branch under a
structured literal `if` stays unreachable. The real `JSON.parse` to `server.handle` witness in
`impl/src/mcp-northbound.mjs` is preserved as a regression gate.

## Validation

- Numbered contract: `spec/phase22/atlas-cpg-path-sensitive.md`.
- Phase 22 focused red/green result: 9/9.
- Combined Phase 18/19/20/22 R3 gate: 29/29.
- Canonical suite: 731/731; owned suite root reaped.
- Baton-on-Baton proof: every check in
  `docs/reference/evidence/phase22-atlas-cpg-path-sensitive-2026-07-11/summary.json` is true. It
  built a 2,000-plus-node graph of the implementation itself, observed real CFG/may-def/copy
  relations, preserved the real MCP taint witness, exercised copy/branch/sanitizer composition,
  reverified deterministically, balanced audit events, and removed its temporary roots.

## Recursive review and disagreement

Two exact-model Grok workers reviewed the prior R3 implementation concurrently through Baton and
were independently fresh-verified, killed, and fully reaped. Both found the incorrect else edge;
one also found the copy-flow/card honesty gap. Their captured reports and normalized events are in
`docs/reference/evidence/phase22-atlas-path-sensitive-grok-review-2026-07-11/`.

After implementation, two more exact-model Grok reviews independently found that `else if` sugar
caused the outer structured `if` to fall back to atomic flow, orphaning the nested branch and
creating a false-negative taint result. A red regression now requires the outer `CFG_FALSE` edge
to enter the nested `if`, requires that condition to be reachable, and preserves a source in the
middle arm through the join. The correction is covered by the 7/7 focused and 729/729 canonical
results. The finding reports and their fully reaped lifecycle evidence are under
`docs/reference/evidence/phase22-atlas-cpg-implementation-grok-review-2026-07-11/`.

The first correction review then found a second composition defect: a structured `if` nested
inside an atomic unsupported parent formed a disconnected CFG island. Its successful Grok 4.5
report produced a red regression; the concurrent Composer process closed before its terminal frame,
and Baton still reaped both workers completely. Effective anchoring now climbs through a
disconnected structured island to the reachable atomic parent, while literal-dead arms remain
dead. Same-name definitions collapsed into one atomic region are retained as a may-union instead
of source-order last-wins. The failed-as-a-whole review attempt is preserved honestly under
`docs/reference/evidence/phase22-atlas-cpg-correction-grok-review-2026-07-11/`.

The implementation deliberately rejected one proposal that would have removed a source-to-sink
path whenever the source occurred in a conditional branch. That is must-path reasoning, not
may-reachability, and would create a false negative when the branch is taken. Baton instead keeps
all may-reaching definitions at an unknown branch join and prunes only source-level boolean
literals.

## Honest boundary

This is not full path feasibility, SSA, a PDG, or a safety/exploitability proof. Shadowing-aware
binding identity, aliases, heap/properties, implicit/control taint, exceptions, general condition
solving, interprocedural parameters/returns, dynamic dispatch, unbraced conditional expansion, and
repository-wide flow remain unclaimed.

1→# Grok SC12 Audit — spawn/stop reconciliation (phase 10.1)
2→
3→**Scope pinned to**: `spec/phase10.1/spawn-stop-reconciliation.md` and `impl/test/phase10.1-reconciliation.test.mjs` plus supporting evidence and implementation in this checkout only (no external sources).
4→
5→**Goal**: Map SC12–SC20 to concrete tests, distinguish session product tier from legacy one-shot adapters, call out remaining coverage concerns.
6→
7→## Session product tier vs legacy one-shot adapters (distinction)
8→
9→The product surface is the **session tier**:
10→- `ClaudeSessionCli`, `CodexAppServerCli`, `GrokAcpCli` (and `GlmSessionCli` subclass of Claude).
11→- Exported from `impl/src/index.mjs:22-24` with explicit comment "SC2: the session tier IS the product surface".
12→- Full persistent session semantics: native `spawn`/`prompt`/`steer`/`interrupt`/`approve`/`kill` where supported; `onEvent` streaming over lifetime; one child process per worker that survives across turns (same PID across `turn_started`/`turn_completed` observed in claude-session.test.mjs, codex-appserver.test.mjs, grok-acp.test.mjs).
13→- Used by `Coordinator` for phase-10/10.1 capstone paths. Implements SC12 pending-spawn reservation + `signal` abort, wall timers (SC18), child reaping on setup failure (SC16), etc.
14→- Cards (pinned by SC8/SC19 in phase10-completion.test.mjs:413-415) declare 8 verbs with honest values (e.g. Grok steer='emulated', Codex approve/answer='native').

17→- `CodexCli`, `ClaudeCli`, `ZCodeCli` (and older `CodexAdapter`/`ClaudeAdapter`/`GlmAdapter`/`MockAdapter` from adapter.mjs).
18→- Defined in `impl/src/cli-adapters.mjs` and `adapter.mjs`.
19→- One-shot `run(brief)` (or equivalent) model: fire-and-forget per turn; many verbs return `{ok:false, emulated:true}` or unsupported (see CARD_CASES in phase10-completion.test.mjs:409-412 defining ONE_SHOT_VERBS and LEGACY_VERBS with 4-8 keys but limited surface).
20→- No mid-flight steer/answer channel; `prompt` emulates as unsupported; interrupt/kill reduce to process signal (no confirmed two-phase for graceful case on pure one-shot).
21→- From `docs/handoff/evidence/phase10.1-adversarial-review.md:73-74`: "The legacy one-shot CLI tier is still explicitly fire-and-forget and is not used by the phase-10 capstone. SC12 applies to the full-session product adapters named by the goal."

23→- Cards normalized under G10/SC8 but values correctly declare reduced capability (e.g. prompt='unsupported').
24→
25→SC12–SC20 contracts and tests target the session product tier (the three CLIs looped in reconciliation tests and pinned in card assertions).

31→### SC12 — spawn is a reserved, cancellable lifecycle
32→Spec: `spec/phase10.1/spawn-stop-reconciliation.md:14-36` (synchronous reservation before first await; duplicate spawn refuses; kill/interrupt during `worktreeReady` cancels without child; re-check after async boundaries; reaps late worktree).

# Grok CPG impl review 45 — Phase 22 PS1–PS8 @ 6fc58c7

Adversarial review of committed Phase 22 path-sensitive CPG against
`spec/phase22/atlas-cpg-path-sensitive.md`, `impl/src/atlas-cpg.mjs`,
`atlas-cpg-delta.mjs`, `atlas-cpg-taint.mjs`, and Phase 18–22 tests. Findings
grounded in source locations and concrete failure sequences. Product non-goals
are separated from PS1–PS8 contract defects.

## Verdict

**Pass with one actionable PS1/PS4 defect.** At 6fc58c7 the structured-if CFG,
join tails, else-if entry, atomic unsupported-control collapse, CFG may-reaching
fixed point + `maxReachDefPairs`, direct copy/argument edges, sanitizer
non-bypass, artifact lifecycle, delta inheritance, and claim language all hold
under red/green Phase 18–22 suites and adversarial probes.

Literal dead-branch pruning is **not** robust to comments inside the condition
text: `if (true/*c*/)` / `if (/*c*/true)` / `if (false/*c*/)` keep both branch
edges and can revive syntax-literal-dead sources into taint. That is a PS1
pruning failure with PS4 false-positive flow, not a product non-goal.

Everything else attempted (mixed braces atomic fallback, bare-block silence,
orphan dead-arm join edges, loop non-expansion) is either a documented PS5
boundary or a non-semantic CFG hygiene nit that does not currently break
reachability or RD.

## Contract matrix

| Seam | Verdict | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| **PS1 structured if CFG** | **Mostly hold; prune hole** | Braced if/else: `CFG_TRUE`/`CFG_FALSE` into arms; non-terminal tails `CFG_NEXT`/`CFG_EXIT` to `joinFor` (`atlas-cpg.mjs:103–141`). Else-if: outer `CFG_FALSE` → nested `if_statement` (`:118–122`, phase22 else-if test). Unbraced then, or alternative neither block nor nested if → whole if stays atomic (`:113–120`). |
| **PS1 joins** | **Hold** | `joinFor` walks sibling sequence then parent (`:103–108`); nested structured tails skipped in `connectTail` so inner join owns exit (`:135–140`). Terminals (`return`/`throw`) skip join (`:95`, `:135`). Empty then: `CFG_TRUE` → join. |
| **PS1 literal prune** | **Defect** | Literal via `condition.text().replace(/[()\s]/g,'')` then `!== 'true'/'false'` (`:123–124`, `:138–139`). Bare `true`/`false`/`(true)` OK; comment-bearing conditions keep both edges (see findings). |
| **PS1 unsupported atomic + collapse** | **Hold** | Loops/switch/try not in `structuredIfs`; body islands not entered from function entry. `effectiveStatement` climbs to reachable outer statement; literal-dead under structured parent still returns null (`:148–161`). phase22 try/switch/nested-if-in-try tests. |
| **PS2 may-RD fixed point** | **Hold** | Per-function gen at effective anchors; in-merge over `cfgIn`; out = kill-replace names in gen (`:167–190`). Join may-union of alternate defs (probe: both branch lines reach use). Unreachable anchors excluded from `anchors` (`:175`). |
| **PS2 may-union on atomic collapse** | **Hold** | Multiple same-name defs map to one reachable anchor Set (`:172–173`); switch fixture taint path length 1; probe shows both case defs in `REACHING_DEF`. Not source-order last-wins. |
| **PS2 ceiling** | **Hold** | Constructor requires positive `maxReachDefPairs` (`:40`); throw `reachdef_too_large` before oversized emit (`:189`). phase22 PS2/PS6 test. |
| **PS2/PS6 statement anchoring** | **Hold** | Statements: BFS `cfgReachable` (`:144–147`). Id/call: `cfgAnchor`/`cfgReachable` via `effectiveStatement` (`:162–165`). Params: no statement → reachable without anchor. |
| **PS3 direct copy/args** | **Hold** | `ASSIGNED_FROM` only direct id/call RHS (`:86–90`, `:194`). `ARGUMENT_TO` only direct id/call args (`:82–84`, `:195`). Nested `outer(inner(y))` does not assign from `inner`; `sanitize(readInput())` does not bypass. |
| **PS4 taint / sanitizer / claim** | **Mostly hold** | Flow edges `ASSIGNED_FROM`/`REACHING_DEF`/`ARGUMENT_TO` (`atlas-cpg-taint.mjs:6`, `:27`). Live filter `cfgReachable !== false` (`:28`). Sanitizer cut when node is not source (`:37`). `provenance.meaning === 'cfg_may_reach_value_graph_not_safety_proof'` (`:42`). Fails when PS1 mis-labels literal-dead arms live. |
| **PS5 non-goals** | **Hold** | Card limitations (`atlas-cpg.mjs:44`); heap/return/interproc red tests empty; bare blocks declared non-spine. |
| **PS6 artifacts** | **Hold** | schemaVersion 2, content-addressed write, sorted nodes/edges (`:197–200`); resume cursor + digest/path/schema checks (`:205–207`); reverify digest equality (`:209`); cancel/partial/ceilings covered in phase18. |
| **PS7 delta** | **Hold** | Builds richer graphs; edge diff includes `REACHING_DEF`; impact walks `REACHING_DEF` as `def_use` (`atlas-cpg-delta.mjs:70–77`, `:107`). `impactMeaning: 'seed_graph_reachability_not_behavioral_proof'` (`:111`). |
| **PS8 acceptance / green** | **Hold with gap** | phase22 covers else/join, may-reach, dead source/sink, copy, sanitizer nest, ceiling, direct arg, heap/return absent, try atomic, else-if, if-in-try, switch may-union. Misses comment-literal prune and dead-arm tail edges. |

## Actionable findings

### F1 — Comment-bearing boolean conditions skip literal prune (PS1 defect → PS4 false positive)

**Where:** `impl/src/atlas-cpg.mjs:123–124` (literal extraction), `:138–139` (edge emit); taint consumes resulting `cfgReachable` in `atlas-cpg-taint.mjs:28`.

**Mechanism:** Literal detection is string equality after stripping only `()` and whitespace. Tree-sitter keeps comments in `condition.text()`:

- `(true/*x*/)` → `true/*x*/` ≠ `true`
- `(/*c*/true)` → `/*c*/true` ≠ `true`
- `(false/*c*/)` → `false/*c*/` ≠ `false`

AST still has a `true`/`false` leaf under `parenthesized_expression`; the contract asks for syntax-literal prune, not “text equals true after crude strip.”

**Failure sequence:**

1. Source: `let value; if (true/*c*/) { value = 1 } else { value = readInput() }; send(value)` (and duals with lead comment / `false/*c*/` dead then).
2. Both `CFG_TRUE` and `CFG_FALSE` emitted from the if.
3. Else-arm (or then-arm) call gets non-null `cfgAnchor` and `cfgReachable: true`.
4. `cpg.taint` with `sourceNames:['readInput']`, `sinkNames:['send']` returns **1 path**.

Contrast: `if (true) { ... } else { value = readInput() }` yields **0** paths (phase22 dead-branch intent).

**Class:** PS1–PS8 contract defect (incomplete literal prune), not a PS5 non-goal.

**Fix direction:** Resolve literal from AST (unwrap parentheses; ignore comment children; accept only boolean leaf `true`/`false`), and apply the same predicate in `effectiveStatement` dead-arm checks (`:154–155`).

### F2 — Dead-arm `connectTail` still emits join edges after prune (PS1 hygiene; low impact)

**Where:** `atlas-cpg.mjs:140` always `connectTail` on consequence and alternative lists after optionally omitting `CFG_TRUE`/`CFG_FALSE`.

**Failure sequence:** `if (false) { left() } done()` → no `CFG_TRUE`, but still `CFG_NEXT left → done`. `left.cfgReachable === false`; RD/taint ignore the orphan because `left` ∉ reachable anchors. Same for `if (true)…else { right() }` orphan `right → done`.

**Class:** Graph hygiene vs “omit the unreachable branch edge.” Not currently a may-reach or taint correctness break. Prefer skipping `connectTail` for arms whose entry edge was omitted.

### Not defects (product / non-goal boundaries)

- **Bare block inside structured if:** `if (flag) { { value = readInput() } }` → def `cfgReachable: false`, taint 0. Card + PS5: bare blocks are not CFG spine nodes.
- **Mixed braces atomic:** `if (flag) { left() } else right()` not expanded (`:120`). Conservative; unbraced alternative refuses structured form.
- **No loop back-edges / switch cases / catch paths:** atomic by PS1/PS5; collapse preserves may-union, not path simulation.
- **Delta projections omit `cfgReachable`:** reachability changes only with structural/CFG edge changes already diffed; impact remains seed reachability, not proof (`atlas-cpg-delta.mjs:34–37`, `:111`).

## Missing regressions

1. **Comment-literal prune (blocks F1):** fixtures for `if (true/*c*/)`, `if (/*c*/true)`, `if (false/*c*/)` with dead-arm `readInput` → assert single live branch edge, dead call `cfgReachable === false`, taint path count 0. Optionally AST-equivalent `(true)` already green.
2. **No join edge from pruned arm (F2):** after literal prune, assert zero `CFG_NEXT`/`CFG_EXIT` from statements solely in the omitted arm to the join.
3. **(Optional product)** bare-block-in-if documentation or explicit “unsupported nesting” status if operators hit false negatives—out of PS8 acceptance text but reduces surprise.

No further actionable PS1–PS8 defect remained after probes of joins, else-if chains, terminals, atomic try/while/switch collapse, may-union, kill-across-diamond, direct args/copies, nested sanitizer, ceilings, resume/tamper/reverify, and delta `REACHING_DEF` impact.

# Phase 22 — Atlas bounded path-sensitive CPG continuation

## PS1 — structured `if` control flow

For braced `if` statements, `CFG_TRUE` enters the consequence and `CFG_FALSE` enters the
alternative when present, otherwise the join. An `else if` alternative enters the nested
`if_statement`; it is not collapsed into atomic fall-through. Every non-terminal branch tail reaches the join.
Literal `true`/`false` conditions omit the unreachable branch edge. Unbraced conditions, loops,
switches, short-circuit expressions, ternaries, and exception constructs remain atomic unless a
    10|later contract expands them.

## PS2 — bounded CFG may-reaching definitions

`REACHING_DEF` means a same-function, same-binding-name definition may reach a reference through
the shipped CFG without another definition of that name on that path. Multiple definitions may
reach a join; this is neither lexical-last-def nor SSA/must-def. Definitions in a CFG-unreachable
literal branch do not reach later references. A deployment-supplied `maxReachDefPairs` ceiling is
mandatory and fails typed before an oversized relation is emitted.
When nested definitions collapse onto one reachable atomic unsupported-control anchor, same-name
    20|definitions form a may-union rather than source-order last-wins.

## PS3 — direct value edges

Identifier-to-identifier declarator/assignment copies emit direct `ASSIGNED_FROM` edges. Call
assignment and `ARGUMENT_TO` edges describe only the direct RHS/direct argument, not every nested
descendant; nested expressions compose through their immediate calls instead of bypassing a
configured sanitizer.

## PS4 — taint consumes CFG truth
    30|
Operator-specified taint retains Phase 20 flow edge types and sanitizer cuts. Source and sink calls
anchored in CFG-unreachable statements are excluded. Richer may-reaching definitions preserve a
possible path across a branch join, while syntax-literal dead branches are pruned. Provenance says
`cfg_may_reach_value_graph_not_safety_proof`; a missing path is not a safety claim.

## PS5 — explicit non-goals

No claim is made for shadowing-aware binding identity, aliases, heap/object properties, implicit
or control taint, exceptions, interprocedural parameters/returns, dynamic dispatch, full PDG, SSA,
    40|SAT/SMT condition solving, repository-wide flow, or unbraced conditional expansion.
Standalone bare statement blocks are not CFG spine nodes in this increment.

## PS6 — artifact and lifecycle integrity

Graph schema/version, content addressing, deterministic order, parse-partial status, cancellation,
result ceilings, bounded resume, tamper refusal, and reverify remain mandatory. Statement/value
nodes expose only deterministic statement anchors and CFG reachability facts derived from source.

## PS7 — delta inheritance
    50|
CPG delta compares the richer graph and impact may follow its richer `REACHING_DEF` relation.
This does not upgrade impact reachability into behavioral proof or path-sensitive impact.

## PS8 — acceptance

Red tests prove else entry and branch joins, literal dead-branch pruning, alternate may-reaching
definitions, direct copy flow, sanitizer non-bypass through nested calls, the mandatory relation
ceiling, retained direct-argument behavior, deterministic artifacts, and the explicit non-goals.
The combined R3 and canonical suites must stay green.

# Adversarial review — CK1–CK8 implementation vs `spec/phase11/coordination-knowledge.md`

Reviewed `impl/src/coordination-store.mjs`, `impl/src/coordinator.mjs`, `impl/src/index.mjs`, `impl/test/phase11-coordination-store.test.mjs`, `impl/test/phase11-acceptance-integration.test.mjs`, and `impl/test/phase11-persistent-sessions.test.mjs`. `impl/VALIDATION.md` reports 519/519 passing; that count is treated as coverage breadth, not contract proof.

## Verdict

**Substrate slice is real; CK8/CK9 fleet gate is not.** `CoordinationStore` implements append idempotency, tail validation, CAS claims, Scratch point checks, bitemporal query, read logging, and contamination records with 17 targeted tests. `createDriver()` exposes `coordination` (`index.mjs:194`). The coordinator writes many paths durably. Two replay authorities still coexist, operational-log append loss remains tolerated, Scratch/knowledge recall are store-only APIs, and several CK9 failure modes have no failing test. 519/519 can stay green while a crash between `task.claimed` and `lifecycle.spawned` orphans a working durable task.

## Critical and major findings
    10|
### CK1 / CK1a — crash atomicity and dual-stream integrity

**Critical — operational append loss is still non-fatal.** CK1a forbids the telemetry sink’s warn-and-drop behavior for state truth. `coordinator.mjs:295–308` wraps `log.append` and returns `undefined` on failure after `process.emitWarning`. Downstream `_coordMapEvent` (`1416–1418`) then returns `null`, and `_coordTransition` may be skipped while in-memory `task.status` still advances (`2345–2346`, `2172`). Coordination-store append failure is correctly fatal (`coordination-store.test.mjs:32–35`); the operational/coordination seam is not.

**Critical — claim-before-spawn crash window.** `_dispatch` durably `claimTask`s (`434–438`) before `lifecycle.spawned` is logged (`506–515`). Crash there leaves coordination `working` with assignee set, but the worker log may be empty. `_seedQueuedCoordinationTasks` (`712–715`) only rehydrates `pending` tasks; `_replay` skips workers with zero events (`2404–2405`). No test exercises this seam; CK9 item 12 covers store append failure only, not coordinator ordering.

**Major — startup evidence validation is optional.** `evidence.mapped` digest checks run in `_apply` only when `operationalRead` is injected (`coordination-store.mjs:119–123`). A hand-edited coordination stream with dangling evidence pointers can load without `operationalRead`; CK1a reconciliation is wired in `createDriver` (`index.mjs:131`) but not proven under tamper.

### CK2 — replay authority, refinement, recovery
    20|
**Critical — coordinator replay ignores coordination DAG truth.** `_replay` (`2401–2643`) rebuilds tasks from per-worker logs with `deps: []` always (`2564`). `lifecycle.spawned` payloads omit `deps` (`508–514`). Queued-task survival is proven only via `_seedQueuedCoordinationTasks` + coordination snapshot (`coordination-store.test.mjs:87–115`), not via `_replay`. A restarted coordinator with completed worker logs but a coordination child still `pending` can dispatch the child early — CK9 items 10–11 are store-level only.

**Major — reservation ≠ claim is split across layers.** Durable `assignee` stays `null` until `task.claimed` (store `_apply:113–115`; test line 114). Coordinator memory sets `assignee: workerId` at spawn (`663`) and dispatches via `task.assignee` (`432`). Correct for the happy path; misleading for CK2 “unassigned until dispatch” audits that read coordinator state.

**Major — refinement/recovery tasks are coordination-only ghosts on replay.** `_createCoordinationRefinement` (`1426–1446`) appends `task.created` + `task.claimed` for recovery refinements. `_replay` never reads coordination tasks; it only folds `control.recovery_attached` / `control.recovery_terminalized` from worker logs (`2483–2521`). PS7 tests rebuild `Coordinator` without reloading the coordination file (`phase11-persistent-sessions.test.mjs:385–400`). Refinement `refines` linkage is asserted in PS1 (`113`) on a live process, not after full driver restart from both streams.

**Major — store cycle refusal is weaker than coordinator.** `createTask` refuses only `deps.includes(fields.id)` (`174`); transitive cycles are unchecked at the store. Coordinator `_assertNoCycle` (`1075–1093`) is stronger. A direct `CoordinationStore` caller can persist cyclic DAGs CK2 forbids.

### CK3 — artifact provenance
    30|
**Major — `artifact.superseded` is absent.** CK3 names correction via new manifest + link. Store handles `artifact.registered` only (`125–128`); no supersession event or edge. Immutability is copy-on-read (`coordination-store.test.mjs:137–138`), not correction semantics.

**Major — acceptance gate is partial.** `registerArtifact` requires `provenance` when `accepted: true` (`229–230`) but does not require terminal/verified task status. Trust-gate wiring registers commit+verification only when `captured?.sha` (`2320–2344`); failed verification still transitions task without manifest registration — acceptable — but nothing prevents registering `accepted: true` artifacts on `pending` tasks via the public store API.

**Major — adapter `WorkerResult.artifacts` prose is unwired.** Manifests come from git capture and `verify.reverified`; worker-emitted file lists never reach `artifact.registered`.

### CK4 — Scratch overlap, expiry, wiring

**Major — Scratch is built, not wired.** No `checkScratch` / `claimScratch` / `postScratchFact` call sites in `coordinator.mjs`. CK4’s hub-slaved lease expiry on worker terminal state is manual `expireScratchClaim` only (`275–282`); no coordinator hook on `kill.confirmed` / terminal transitions. Store tests pass (`198–226`); fleet workers cannot reach Scratch through the driver.
    40|
**Major — glob–glob overlap may false-negative.** CK4 requires conflict when disjointness cannot be proven, including witness-based glob pairs. `resourceOverlap` (`30–36`) uses literal-prefix prefix test for glob–glob; patterns like `path:payments/*` vs `*stripe.js` can share witnesses but disjoint prefixes. Test covers glob-vs-exact (`205–207`), not witness failure. `globRegex` (`17–27`) embeds `.+` inside the escape branch — suspicious regex construction worth adversarial fixture review.

**Minor — fact lookup asymmetry.** `checkScratch` matches `fact.key === resource || fact.resource === resource` (`290`), but `postScratchFact` stores `namespace`/`key` without `resource` (`243–251`). Namespace-qualified facts may not surface on path-shaped checks.

### CK5 / CK7 — bitemporal causality, reads, contamination

**Major — bitemporal model is partial.** Nodes carry `observedSeq`/`validFrom`/`validTo` but no distinct event-time dimension (CK5: “event time (referenced source seq/time)”). `queryKnowledge` filters `observedSeq` (`340–343`), not `observedAt` timestamps despite the spec’s `asOf` + `observedAt` pairing.

**Major — `ReadBy` edges are never materialized.** CK5/CK7 require graph `ReadBy` edges from recalled nodes to reader task/run on every logged read. `readKnowledge` appends `knowledge.read` (`354–360`) but `_apply` for that kind only pushes `_knowledgeReads` (`153–154`); no edge projection.
    50|
**Major — `affectedReaders` omits task status.** CK7 projects downstream tasks “including current task status.” Implementation returns raw read records (`375–377`) without joining coordination task status — a stub-shaped API that passes `affectedReaders('old').length === 1` (`254`) without routing-safety proof.

**Major — multi-node contamination is single-node keyed.** Invalidating node `new` after a read that returned `{old,new}` records zero affected reads (`252–253`) because the read’s `nodeIds` at recall time filtered to `asOf` January view (`245–246`). Correct for that read, but no test proves blast-radius when a later broader read included both nodes and one is invalidated — CK7 “multi-event contamination” gap.

**Major — failed read logging is store-only.** `readKnowledge` append-before-return is correct (`354–360`; test `264–267`). No coordinator/recall path calls it; CK7 “unlogged read is failed operation” is untested on any worker/orchestrator integration path.

**Major — Decision evidence checks edges in name only.** `addKnowledgeNode` requires `evidence.length > 0` for `Decision` (`311`) but does not require an `Informed` edge; test adds edge after node (`235–236`), not as admission gate.

### CK6 — promotion
    60|
**Later scope:** scorecards, RouteStat, lexical recall — correctly deferred per spec.

**Major — promotion events missing.** No `knowledge.promoted` or `knowledge.promotion_candidate` kinds. Coordinator calls `addKnowledgeNode` directly for outcomes/integration/publication (`2338–2343`, `1024–1028`, `1831–1835`). Deterministic hooks exist but not as named promotion events CK6 describes; `auditKnowledge` (`385–402`) is never gated in tests.

### CK8 — authority and built-not-wired

**Critical — coordination remains optional inside `Coordinator`.** `opts.coordination ?? null` (`258`); every helper no-ops when null (`1403`, `1412`, `1422`, `1427`). `createDriver` always constructs a store, but hand-wired tests across 502 other cases can omit it. CK9 item 13 (“nonempty coordinator, empty substrate must fail”) has no test.

**Major — coordinator replay authority contradicts CK8.** CK8 makes coordination mandatory for state-changing paths; `_replay` still treats per-worker logs as authoritative for task status, deps, and terminalization (`2398–2399`, `2560–2602`). Coordination is a sidecar writer, not the rebuild source, except for pending queue seeding.
    70|
**Major — refused integration is telemetry-only.** `integration.refused` logs (`1002–1006`) but writes no `driver.recorded` or coordination artifact/event — asymmetric with `integration.completed` (`1018–1029`).

## Contract corrections

| ID | Correction |
|---|---|
| **CK1** | Require coordinator operational `append` failure to abort the triggering mutation (mirror store fatal append). Add CK9 probe: inject `log.append` throw after `task.claimed`; coordination and coordinator projections must match after restart. |
| **CK1a** | Mandate `operationalRead` at `CoordinationStore` construction for any assembly that replays worker logs; startup `_load` must reject `evidence.mapped` rows whose digest cannot be verified. |
| **CK2** | Single replay authority: rebuild coordinator `_tasks` from coordination projections first; worker logs may enrich session/vendor fields but must not override `deps`, `status`, or `assignee`. Persist `deps` on `lifecycle.spawned` until replay is unified. Extend `_seedQueuedCoordinationTasks` to all non-terminal coordination tasks or drop worker-log task reconstruction. |
    80|| **CK2** | Store `createTask` must run the same cycle detection as coordinator `spawn`. Recovery refinements must persist a durable link (`refines`, parent `terminalEvent`) recoverable without live memory. |
... 17 lines not shown ...

    70|
**Major — refused integration is telemetry-only.** `integration.refused` logs (`1002–1006`) but writes no `driver.recorded` or coordination artifact/event — asymmetric with `integration.completed` (`1018–1029`).

# Phase 19 — Atlas CPG delta and impact

## CD1 — two immutable graph authorities

`AtlasCpgDelta` builds independently content-addressed Phase 18 graphs from one confined before
file and one confined after file. The delta pins both source and graph digests; neither worker
claims nor caller-supplied graph JSON is authoritative.

## CD2 — semantic matching keys
    10|
Revision-local IDs remain source-digest-bound. Delta matching instead derives deterministic keys
from function/container name, node type/kind/name/role, and occurrence ordinal. Range-only movement
and formatting do not fabricate changes. Rename or ambiguous duplicate identity remains explicit
remove/add rather than guessed continuity.

## CD3 — node and edge delta

The result classifies added, removed, and modified semantic nodes plus added/removed typed edges.
Statement modification compares syntax fingerprints, not raw trivia. Every record retains the
    20|before/after revision-local IDs and ranges needed to inspect the exact evidence.

## CD4 — bounded impact traversal

Changed syntax/def-use/call nodes lift through `CONTAINS` to their function, flow along
`REACHING_DEF`, and propagate to callers over reverse `CALLS`. Results name reason and distance.
The requested traversal depth is bounded by a deployment-derived constructor ceiling.

## CD5 — no semantic overclaim

    30|Impact means graph reachability under the shipped seed, not proof of runtime behavioral effect.
Unresolved calls, aliases, dynamic dispatch, path conditions, interprocedural dataflow, and taint
remain absent and cannot silently create edges.

## CD6 — parse health, cancellation, and bounds

Either graph's parse errors make the delta `partial`. Cancellation and source/artifact ceilings
fail typed. The delta artifact has its own deployment-derived bound.

## CD7 — bounded context, resume, and reverify
    40|
The complete delta and impact set is immutable and content-addressed. Inline payload is
token-bounded; cursors are artifact/digest/offset-bound and tamper-checked. Reverify rebuilds both
graphs and compares the delta digest.

## CD8 — acceptance

Focused tests cover formatting invariance, syntax/edge change classification, caller impact,
rename honesty, depth bounds, parse partials, cancellation, resume/tamper refusal, deterministic
reverify, and a Baton-on-Baton before/after proof.

Reviewed `spec/phase22/atlas-cpg-path-sensitive.md`, `impl/src/atlas-cpg.mjs`, `impl/src/atlas-cpg-delta.mjs`, `impl/src/atlas-cpg-taint.mjs`, and `impl/test/phase18-atlas-cpg.test.mjs`, `impl/test/phase19-atlas-cpg-delta.test.mjs`, `impl/test/phase20-atlas-cpg-taint.test.mjs`, `impl/test/phase22-atlas-cpg-path-sensitive.test.mjs`. Commit `6fc58c7` ("Harden atomic CPG flow after correction review") is the implementation land point. Cross-checked with local adversarial probes (else-if-only source, literal pruning, atomic may-union, sanitizer copy chains, delta `REACHING_DEF` sensitivity, shadowing). Phase 18–22 suites: 29/29 passing.

## Verdict

**ACCEPT — no actionable PS1–PS8 defects remain at `6fc58c7`.**

Braced `if`/`else`, `else if` chains, literal `true`/`false` pruning, branch joins, may-`REACHING_DEF` with mandatory `maxReachDefPairs`, direct copy/argument edges, sanitizer non-bypass, atomic unsupported-control collapse (with may-union), taint CFG gating, artifact lifecycle, delta inheritance, and claim language all match the Phase 22 contract for in-scope shapes. The correction commit fixes the prior `else if` gate failure (outer `if` dropped when alternative was nested `if_statement`) and the atomic last-wins reaching-def bug (single `def` per name at a gen anchor). Residual limitations (shadowing, heap flow, literal-only pruning, Phase 19 semantic delta keys) are explicit non-goals or inherited product boundaries, not PS1–PS8 falsifications.

## Contract matrix

| Seam | Verdict | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| **PS1** structured `if` CFG, joins, literal prune, atomic collapse | **PASS** | Gate accepts braced consequence plus block or nested `if_statement` alternative (`atlas-cpg.mjs:109–124`). Emits `CFG_TRUE`/`CFG_FALSE` with literal gating (`:123–124`, `:136–140`). `connectTail` joins non-terminal tails (`:135–140`); `terminal()` and nested structured ifs suppress bogus join edges (`:135`). `else if` false edge to inner if: `phase22-…test.mjs:96–114`; probe `CFG_FALSE` outer→inner passes. Literal prune: `if(true)`/`if(false)` omit opposite edges (probe); dead else arm taint blocked (`phase22-…test.mjs:116–120`). Unbraced `if` stays `CFG_NEXT`-only atomic (probe). Unsupported `try`/`switch` atomic; nested structured if collapses to outer anchor without reviving literal-dead arm (`phase22-…test.mjs:90–94`, `:116–120`). |
| **PS2** may-reaching-def fixed point, ceiling, atomic may-union | **PASS** | Gen stores `Set` of def ids per name (`:172–174`); fixed point unions predecessor outgoing then kills/gens at anchor (`:177–185`). References use pre-gen `incoming` (`:187–189`). Mandatory `maxReachDefPairs` constructor + `reachdef_too_large` (`:40`, `:189`); `phase22-…test.mjs:72–76`. Alternate branch may-def at join (`phase22-…test.mjs:43–47`). Switch may-union (`:123–126`); two defs on one atomic anchor both reach sink (probe). Literal-dead defs excluded via `effectiveStatement` (`:148–160`) and unreachable CFG (`:145–147`). |
| **PS3** direct `ASSIGNED_FROM` / `ARGUMENT_TO` | **PASS** | Only direct identifier/call RHS and direct call arguments (`:86–90`, `:193–195`). Phase 18 `CG4` and Phase 22 copy chain `['ASSIGNED_FROM','REACHING_DEF',…]` (`phase22-…test.mjs:58–63`). Nested `send(readInput())` is one `ARGUMENT_TO` (`phase22-…test.mjs:78–81`). |
| **PS4** taint consumes CFG; sanitizer cuts; provenance | **PASS** | `live()` gates sources/sinks on `cfgReachable !== false` (`atlas-cpg-taint.mjs:28`). Dead-branch sources/sinks excluded (`phase22-…test.mjs:49–55`). Sanitizer stops traversal at call node (`:37`); nested `sanitize(readInput())` blocked (`phase22-…test.mjs:65–68`); copy-via-sanitizer chain blocked (probe). Provenance `cfg_may_reach_value_graph_not_safety_proof` (`:42`, `phase22-…test.mjs:82`). |
| **PS5** explicit non-goals | **PASS** (honest) | Card limitations (`atlas-cpg.mjs:44`). Heap `o.x` and `wrap()` return flows absent (`phase22-…test.mjs:84–87`). Shadowing conflates names → may taint false positive (probe: inner `let x=readInput()` reaches outer `send(x)`); documented PS5 gap, not a seam defect. |
| **PS6** artifact schema, bounds, resume, reverify, anchoring | **PASS** | `schemaVersion: 2`, content-addressed `wx` artifacts, tamper refusal (`atlas-cpg.mjs:198–207`). `cfgAnchor`/`cfgReachable` on value nodes (`:162–165`). Phase 18 `CG7` resume/reverify; parse-partial (`CG6`). |
| **PS7** delta inherits richer graph / `REACHING_DEF` impact | **PASS** (inherited semantics) | Delta builds Phase 22 graphs via shared `AtlasCpgSlice` (`atlas-cpg-delta.mjs:98`). Impact traverses `REACHING_DEF` (`:73–77`). Removing an `if` branch surfaces `REACHING_DEF` edge removals (probe: 2 edge changes). Literal-only RHS tweak (`x=2`→`x=3`) yields `nodesModified` + impact but zero `REACHING_DEF` edge delta entries because Phase 19 CD2 semantic keys collapse same-name def/use pairs — inherited design, not PS22 regression. |
| **PS8** acceptance tests + green suites | **PASS** | Nine Phase 22 tests cover PS1–PS6 seams (`phase22-atlas-cpg-path-sensitive.test.mjs`). Combined with Phase 18–20: 29/29 green. |

## Actionable findings

**No actionable PS1–PS8 defects remain.**

Prior defects at earlier tips are closed at `6fc58c7`:

1. **`else if` structured-if drop (was PS1/PS4 FAIL).** Before correction, `alternativeBody?.kind() === 'if_statement'` was not admitted (`continue` at `:120`), orphaning then-bodies and false-negative `else if` taint. Fixed at `:117–118`; regression `phase22-…test.mjs:96–114` and probe (source only in `else if` arm → 1 path).

2. **Atomic last-wins reaching-def (was PS2 FAIL).** Before correction, gen stored one `def` id per name (`defs.set(item.name, item.id)`), dropping alternate defs collapsed to the same anchor. Fixed to `Set` may-union (`:172–174`, `:182–183`); spec clause added (`spec/phase22/…md:19–20`). Regression `phase22-…test.mjs:123–126` and try-block probe (two defs → 1 may-path).

**Product gaps (not PS1–PS8 defects):**

- **Shadowing:** name-only `REACHING_DEF` can connect shadowed inner defs to outer references (probe above). PS5 disclaims shadowing-aware identity.
- **Literal pruning scope:** only parenthesized/spaced `true`/`false` text (`:123`); `True`, `1`, or symbolic conditions keep both CFG edges — spec-scoped, not a solver claim.
- **Delta semantic projection:** Phase 19 CD2 keys hide raw `REACHING_DEF` id churn when syntaxDigest-stable; impact still seeds from modified statements.
- **Fixed-point iteration:** no explicit iteration ceiling (only pair ceiling); finite lattice guarantees termination on shipped CFG shapes.

## Missing regressions

| Gap | Suggested probe | Class |
|---|---|---|
| Literal `if(true)` / `if(false)` CFG edge omission | Assert no `CFG_FALSE`/`CFG_TRUE` respectively | PS1 regression |
| `if(cond){…}` without `else` — `CFG_FALSE` to join | Assert false edge targets join follower, not skipped | PS1 regression |
| `if(true)` dead else + `if(false)` dead then taint | Complement `:116–120` | PS4 regression |
| Return/throw tail does not join follower | `if(flag){return}else{stmt};done` — no `CFG_NEXT` from return to done | PS1 regression |
| Delta branch removal changes `REACHING_DEF` | Assert `edgeChanges` contains `REACHING_DEF` remove/add | PS7 regression |
| Delta literal RHS tweak impact-only | Document expected zero `REACHING_DEF` edge delta under CD2 keys | PS7 documentation |
| Shadowing false-positive taint | Inner shadow def must not reach outer ref (would fail today; documents PS5) | PS5 negative test |
| `maxReachDefPairs` propagated via taint/delta constructors | Reject missing bound in Phase 19/20 tests | PS6 regression |
| Sanitizer + multi-hop copy `v→sanitize(v)→b→send(b)` | Already passes (probe); add pinned test | PS3/PS4 regression |
| Bare nested blocks not CFG spine nodes | Card claims (`atlas-cpg.mjs:44`); no CFG exercise | PS5/PS6 regression |

These are test-hardening items. None block acceptance of `6fc58c7` against the shipped PS1–PS8 contract.

Reviewed `spec/phase22/atlas-cpg-path-sensitive.md`, `impl/src/atlas-cpg.mjs`, `impl/src/atlas-cpg-delta.mjs`, `impl/src/atlas-cpg-taint.mjs`, and `impl/test/phase18-atlas-cpg.test.mjs`, `impl/test/phase19-atlas-cpg-delta.test.mjs`, `impl/test/phase20-atlas-cpg-taint.test.mjs`, `impl/test/phase22-atlas-cpg-path-sensitive.test.mjs`. Commit `6fc58c7` ("Harden atomic CPG flow after correction review") is the implementation land point. Cross-checked with local adversarial probes (else-if-only source, literal pruning, atomic may-union, sanitizer copy chains, delta `REACHING_DEF` sensitivity, shadowing). Phase 18–22 suites: 29/29 passing.

## Verdict

**ACCEPT — no actionable PS1–PS8 defects remain at `6fc58c7`.**

Braced `if`/`else`, `else if` chains, literal `true`/`false` pruning, branch joins, may-`REACHING_DEF` with mandatory `maxReachDefPairs`, direct copy/argument edges, sanitizer non-bypass, atomic unsupported-control collapse (with may-union), taint CFG gating, artifact lifecycle, delta inheritance, and claim language all match the Phase 22 contract for in-scope shapes. The correction commit fixes the prior `else if` gate failure (outer `if` dropped when alternative was nested `if_statement`) and the atomic last-wins reaching-def bug (single `def` per name at a gen anchor). Residual limitations (shadowing, heap flow, literal-only pruning, Phase 19 semantic delta keys) are explicit non-goals or inherited product boundaries, not PS1–PS8 falsifications.

## Contract matrix

| Seam | Verdict | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| **PS1** structured `if` CFG, joins, literal prune, atomic collapse | **PASS** | Gate accepts braced consequence plus block or nested `if_statement` alternative (`atlas-cpg.mjs:109–124`). Emits `CFG_TRUE`/`CFG_FALSE` with literal gating (`:123–124`, `:136–140`). `connectTail` joins non-terminal tails (`:135–140`); `terminal()` and nested structured ifs suppress bogus join edges (`:135`). `else if` false edge to inner if: `phase22-…test.mjs:96–114`; probe `CFG_FALSE` outer→inner passes. Literal prune: `if(true)`/`if(false)` omit opposite edges (probe); dead else arm taint blocked (`phase22-…test.mjs:116–120`). Unbraced `if` stays `CFG_NEXT`-only atomic (probe). Unsupported `try`/`switch` atomic; nested structured if collapses to outer anchor without reviving literal-dead arm (`phase22-…test.mjs:90–94`, `:116–120`). |
| **PS2** may-reaching-def fixed point, ceiling, atomic may-union | **PASS** | Gen stores `Set` of def ids per name (`:172–174`); fixed point unions predecessor outgoing then kills/gens at anchor (`:177–185`). References use pre-gen `incoming` (`:187–189`). Mandatory `maxReachDefPairs` constructor + `reachdef_too_large` (`:40`, `:189`); `phase22-…test.mjs:72–76`. Alternate branch may-def at join (`phase22-…test.mjs:43–47`). Switch may-union (`:123–126`); two defs on one atomic anchor both reach sink (probe). Literal-dead defs excluded via `effectiveStatement` (`:148–160`) and unreachable CFG (`:145–147`). |
| **PS3** direct `ASSIGNED_FROM` / `ARGUMENT_TO` | **PASS** | Only direct identifier/call RHS and direct call arguments (`:86–90`, `:193–195`). Phase 18 `CG4` and Phase 22 copy chain `['ASSIGNED_FROM','REACHING_DEF',…]` (`phase22-…test.mjs:58–63`). Nested `send(readInput())` is one `ARGUMENT_TO` (`phase22-…test.mjs:78–81`). |
| **PS4** taint consumes CFG; sanitizer cuts; provenance | **PASS** | `live()` gates sources/sinks on `cfgReachable !== false` (`atlas-cpg-taint.mjs:28`). Dead-branch sources/sinks excluded (`phase22-…test.mjs:49–55`). Sanitizer stops traversal at call node (`:37`); nested `sanitize(readInput())` blocked (`phase22-…test.mjs:65–68`); copy-via-sanitizer chain blocked (probe). Provenance `cfg_may_reach_value_graph_not_safety_proof` (`:42`, `phase22-…test.mjs:82`). |
| **PS5** explicit non-goals | **PASS** (honest) | Card limitations (`atlas-cpg.mjs:44`). Heap `o.x` and `wrap()` return flows absent (`phase22-…test.mjs:84–87`). Shadowing conflates names → may taint false positive (probe: inner `let x=readInput()` reaches outer `send(x)`); documented PS5 gap, not a seam defect. |
| **PS6** artifact schema, bounds, resume, reverify, anchoring | **PASS** | `schemaVersion: 2`, content-addressed `wx` artifacts, tamper refusal (`atlas-cpg.mjs:198–207`). `cfgAnchor`/`cfgReachable` on value nodes (`:162–165`). Phase 18 `CG7` resume/reverify; parse-partial (`CG6`). |
| **PS7** delta inherits richer graph / `REACHING_DEF` impact | **PASS** (inherited semantics) | Delta builds Phase 22 graphs via shared `AtlasCpgSlice` (`atlas-cpg-delta.mjs:98`). Impact traverses `REACHING_DEF` (`:73–77`). Removing an `if` branch surfaces `REACHING_DEF` edge removals (probe: 2 edge changes). Literal-only RHS tweak (`x=2`→`x=3`) yields `nodesModified` + impact but zero `REACHING_DEF` edge delta entries because Phase 19 CD2 semantic keys collapse same-name def/use pairs — inherited design, not PS22 regression. |
| **PS8** acceptance tests + green suites | **PASS** | Nine Phase 22 tests cover PS1–PS6 seams (`phase22-atlas-cpg-path-sensitive.test.mjs`). Combined with Phase 18–20: 29/29 green. |

## Actionable findings

**No actionable PS1–PS8 defects remain.**

Prior defects at earlier tips are closed at `6fc58c7`:

1. **`else if` structured-if drop (was PS1/PS4 FAIL).** Before correction, `alternativeBody?.kind() === 'if_statement'` was not admitted (`continue` at `:120`), orphaning then-bodies and false-negative `else if` taint. Fixed at `:117–118`; regression `phase22-…test.mjs:96–114` and probe (source only in `else if` arm → 1 path).

2. **Atomic last-wins reaching-def (was PS2 FAIL).** Before correction, gen stored one `def` id per name (`defs.set(item.name, item.id)`), dropping alternate defs collapsed to the same anchor. Fixed to `Set` may-union (`:172–174`, `:182–183`); spec clause added (`spec/phase22/…md:19–20`). Regression `phase22-…test.mjs:123–126` and try-block probe (two defs → 1 may-path).

**Product gaps (not PS1–PS8 defects):**

- **Shadowing:** name-only `REACHING_DEF` can connect shadowed inner defs to outer references (probe above). PS5 disclaims shadowing-aware identity.
- **Literal pruning scope:** only parenthesized/spaced `true`/`false` text (`:123`); `True`, `1`, or symbolic conditions keep both CFG edges — spec-scoped, not a solver claim.
- **Delta semantic projection:** Phase 19 CD2 keys hide raw `REACHING_DEF` id churn when syntaxDigest-stable; impact still seeds from modified statements.
- **Fixed-point iteration:** no explicit iteration ceiling (only pair ceiling); finite lattice guarantees termination on shipped CFG shapes.

## Missing regressions

| Gap | Suggested probe | Class |
|---|---|---|
| Literal `if(true)` / `if(false)` CFG edge omission | Assert no `CFG_FALSE`/`CFG_TRUE` respectively | PS1 regression |
| `if(cond){…}` without `else` — `CFG_FALSE` to join | Assert false edge targets join follower, not skipped | PS1 regression |
| `if(true)` dead else + `if(false)` dead then taint | Complement `:116–120` | PS4 regression |
| Return/throw tail does not join follower | `if(flag){return}else{stmt};done` — no `CFG_NEXT` from return to done | PS1 regression |
| Delta branch removal changes `REACHING_DEF` | Assert `edgeChanges` contains `REACHING_DEF` remove/add | PS7 regression |
| Delta literal RHS tweak impact-only | Document expected zero `REACHING_DEF` edge delta under CD2 keys | PS7 documentation |
| Shadowing false-positive taint | Inner shadow def must not reach outer ref (would fail today; documents PS5) | PS5 negative test |
| `maxReachDefPairs` propagated via taint/delta constructors | Reject missing bound in Phase 19/20 tests | PS6 regression |
| Sanitizer + multi-hop copy `v→sanitize(v)→b→send(b)` | Already passes (probe); add pinned test | PS3/PS4 regression |
| Bare nested blocks not CFG spine nodes | Card claims (`atlas-cpg.mjs:44`); no CFG exercise | PS5/PS6 regression |

These are test-hardening items. None block acceptance of `6fc58c7` against the shipped PS1–PS8 contract.
